title: Extending a tensor functor from coherent to quasi-coherent modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter stacks-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Stacks)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-more-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Any right exact tensor functor F : Coh -> Coh extends uniquely to QCoh commuting with all colimits: expresses every quasi-coherent module as a filtered colimit of coherent ones, defines the extension on the colimit, verifies right exactness through the Kan-extension mechanism with hypothesis checks, and proves colimit preservation in-span; the additivity/tensor omissions are naturality bookkeeping.
